headline: Whalaska
title: Whalaska | Ice Water Fishing Mount | Palworld Guide
video_script: Whalaska is a huge Ice and Water Pal that you can ride. Its partner skill, Chilled Whale Cruiser, helps with fishing while it is in your party, because the fishing minigame starts with a bigger capture gauge and progress rises faster. At your base it cools at level six and waters at level five. It is a great pick for a lakeside base. Would you ride Whalaska? Comment below!
joke: Whalaska is the only fishing buddy that is bigger than the lake.
description: Whalaska in Palworld 1.0: Ice and Water Pal, rideable. Chilled Whale Cruiser gives a 5 to 14 percent fishing boost (starting gauge and capture progress). Cooling 6, Watering 5. Checked on Pindrop, palworld.gg and Pal Breed Calc in November 2026.
